title: Coding Agent Outcome Contract Schema (STD-023 v1.5.0)
description: Canonical schema for Layer 2 Coding Agent Outcome submissions (POST /api/coding/outcome). Strictly separated from Layer 1 Model Invocation Feedback (POST /api/model/feedback). Enforces one-attempt-one-sample semantics, zero raw source/patch storage, and authentic provenance.

outcome_stage.description: Outcome lifecycle stage. ATTEMPT_COMPLETED records the engineering result of one independent coding attempt; INTEGRATION_DECISION updates integration_selected and final delivery metadata for the same coding_attempt_id without creating a second sample.

idempotency_key.description: Deterministic stage-aware deduplication key. Defaults to {consumer}::{repo_id}::{task_id}::{agent_run_id}::{coding_attempt_id}::{outcome_stage}.

observed_at.description: Canonical ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the coding outcome was observed (e.g. 2026-09-30T08:00:00Z). Defaults to server UTC ingestion time if omitted.

consumer.description: Authoritative consumer project or orchestrator identity (e.g. vtip-ai-sidecar, claude-code, opencode, ai-hub).

coding_client.description: Coding agent client or harness (e.g. claude-code, opencode, codex, sidecar-bakeoff-runner).

agent_run_id.description: Unique identifier for the agent orchestration run.

coding_attempt_id.description: Unique identifier for one independent coding attempt. One coding_attempt_id equals exactly ONE Coding Memory sample.

parent_attempt_id.description: Optional reference to a prior coding_attempt_id when this attempt is a separate repair attempt.

attribution_mode.description: Attribution policy for the attempt. R1 enforces SINGLE_PRIMARY_MODEL per independent coding attempt.

base_commit.description: Authentic Git base commit SHA before the coding attempt.

result_commit.description: Authentic Git commit SHA produced by the coding attempt when committed.

task_profile.description: Canonical coding task profile for fine-grained Coding Memory partitioning.

repo_stack.description: Repository technology stack identifier (e.g. python_fastapi, python_playwright, typescript_node).

decision_id.description: Routing decision_id or frozen candidate_plan_id from Hub.

candidate_plan_id.description: Explicit frozen Coding Candidate Plan identifier when evaluating Bake-Off candidates.

candidate_rank.description: 1-based candidate rank within the Candidate Plan.

virtual_model.description: Coding Gateway virtual model if invoked through Gateway (e.g. hub-code-auto, hub-code-deep).

logical_model_id.description: Canonical primary logical model ID for this independent coding attempt (e.g. qwen3-coder-next, gpt-5.4).

upstream_model_id.description: Verified upstream model identifier returned by provider when authoritative. Omit or null if unverified.

upstream_provider.description: Authoritative upstream provider name when verified (e.g. Alibaba, OpenAI). Omit or null if unverified.

resource_id.description: Canonical shared inference resource identifier (e.g. local-cpa, cloud-cpa, local-ollama).

patch_created.description: Whether the coding attempt produced a patch or code modification.

patch_parse_success.description: Whether the generated patch/edit blocks parsed cleanly without format errors.

patch_apply_success.description: Whether the patch/changes applied cleanly to the working tree.

patch_hash.description: SHA-256 digest of the normalized patch. Raw patch/diff text MUST NOT be submitted.

files_changed_count.description: Number of files modified in the attempt.

lines_added.description: Total lines added in the attempt.

lines_deleted.description: Total lines deleted in the attempt.

syntax_check_run.description: Whether syntax check (e.g. py_compile / AST parse) was executed.

syntax_check_pass.description: Whether syntax check passed. Null if not executed.

lint_pass.description: Whether linter passed. Null if not executed.

typecheck_run.description: Whether static type check was executed.

typecheck_pass.description: Whether static type check passed. Null if not executed.

targeted_tests_run.description: Number of targeted unit/feature tests executed. Null if not run.

targeted_tests_passed.description: Number of targeted tests that passed. Null if not run.

targeted_tests_failed.description: Number of targeted tests that failed. Null if not run.

core_regression_run.description: Number of core regression tests executed. Null if not run.

core_regression_passed.description: Number of core regression tests that passed. Null if not run.

core_regression_failed.description: Number of core regression tests that failed. Null if not run.

build_pass.description: Whether build/packaging passed. Null if not executed.

browser_acceptance_run.description: Whether Playwright/browser UI acceptance was executed.

browser_acceptance_pass.description: Whether Playwright/browser UI acceptance passed. Null if not executed.

acceptance_gates_total.description: Total number of acceptance gates evaluated. Null if not evaluated.

acceptance_gates_passed.description: Number of acceptance gates that passed. Null if not evaluated.

task_outcome.description: Canonical engineering outcome of the coding attempt.

failure_stage.description: Structured stage where failure or partial stop occurred. Null or empty when task_outcome=COMPLETED.

failure_reason_code.description: Structured machine-readable failure reason code (e.g. assertion_error_in_targeted_test). Never store raw code or stack dumps.

integration_selected.description: Whether this candidate attempt was selected for final branch integration. Null when integration decision has not yet occurred. task_outcome=COMPLETED with integration_selected=false is valid and non-penalizing.

generation_latency_ms.description: Total LLM generation latency in milliseconds when accurately measurable.

wall_time_ms.description: Total end-to-end wall clock time for the coding attempt in milliseconds.

model_call_count.description: Number of LLM API requests made during this coding attempt.

tool_call_count.description: Number of agent tool calls executed during this coding attempt.

repair_rounds.description: Number of self-repair rounds within the same primary model attempt.

retry_count.description: Number of transport/invocation retries during the attempt.

human_intervention_required.description: Whether manual human intervention was required during the attempt.

human_intervention_count.description: Number of manual human interventions required.

commit_created.description: Whether a Git commit was created for this attempt.

git_clean.description: Whether the Git working tree was clean after completion.

remote_push_performed.description: Whether the commit was pushed to a remote repository.

task_complete.description: Whether the overall task was marked complete.
